done_when: The generated forge.yml that gates merging runs the tests as the parallel groups, with one required check that passes only when every group passes, for this repo and for client repos on init and after upgrade and sync

findings.body: Raise: Functional. A client with pytest-split in pyproject.toml and `test = "uv run --group test pytest"` calls pytest directly, but the matcher cannot consume the named `test` argument after `--group`. Init and sync therefore generate only `group: [1]`, leaving that client on the serial merge gate after upgrade too. The same gap affects `uv run --extra test pytest`. [uv documents these options](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/cli/).
findings.title: Not done: Direct pytest calls with named uv options remain serial

findings.body: Raise: Gate. The submitted proof list names only the six-group init/doctor test and the stale-doctor test. It omits `test_1_one_tests_check_passes_only_when_every_group_passes`, which checks the required aggregate gate for new, previously adopted, and Forge-source repos after sync, and `test_2_small_split_suite_passes_without_hiding_errors`, which checks the accepted empty-group behavior. Neither listed entry proves those outcomes, so the pull request's proof list leaves the main Done-when behavior unaccounted for.
